messages:
Nina Gomez: Quick postmortem follow-up 1: recurring cold-start p99 spikes. Need owners for SLO edits + fixes.
Theo Martin: Short summary: observed 5 incidents in 30d, p95 ~120ms baseline, p99 spikes 480-550ms correlated with scale-ups.
Rina Chen: Agree. Proposal: p95 <= 140ms (30d rolling), p99 tiered: dedicated <=300ms, hosted <=350ms, and a 5m burst-window SLI p99 <=400ms.
Theo Martin: I'll own runtime mitigation (cold-pool routing & warmup jitter). Plan: triage 3d, PoC 1w, canary 2d.
Rina Chen: I'll update dashboards and add a tail alert rule. Draft alert: when p99 > 320ms for 10m page on dedicated, non-page at 350ms for hosted.
Nina Gomez: Ops changes: add tail-check to daily handoff, coordinate SLA wording with legal.
ops-bot: Alert 2471234501: p99_latency > 400ms for 15m triggered 2 times in prod-us-west.
Theo Martin: Also adding a synthetic cold-start job to CI (cold-start-smoke) to reproduce. ETA Thu.
Rina Chen: Dashboard query (PromQL) I will add to PR: histogram_quantile(0.99, sum(rate(http_request_duration_seconds_bucket[5m])) by (le)). Will include compare vs instance_boot_count.
Nina Gomez: Action items: Rina -> dashboard+alerts PR by Tue EOD; Theo -> PoC + benchmark by next Fri; Nina -> SLA draft and customer comms by Wed. Weekly 15-min check on Thursdays 9am PT.
Theo Martin: Starting triage now, will attach logs to runtime GH issue.
Rina Chen: I'll open observability PR and tag the monitoring team.
Nina Gomez: Thanks team. Track progress in the SLO sprint board and escalate blockers to oncall.
